decision.explanation: Two distinct documents (D1S2/D1S3 and D3S2) directly name architects for the Elks Club Building in Manila, the Philippines. Document D1S2/D1S3 attributes the design to William E. Parsons, while D3S2 attributes it to Frank Lloyd Wright. These are competing assertions about the same referent (the architect of the Elks Club Building in Manila), but both are explicitly stated in their respective sources. Neither source is marked as satirical or unreliable, and both are treated as valid in the audit. Therefore, both names are retained as valid answers.
